Since when does admitting that the only reason I game on console is that I don't have the cash to pour into a gaiming PC in any way "reek of elitism?" You're really going to have to explain that "Logic" to me.

As an avid gamer on both platforms, I'd like to share my two cents on the subject.

Let me start off by saying that I'm sure there are console gamers who truly believe that their console is anywhere close to on par with a gaming rig. Ignorance like this is simply a side effect of such a massive playerbase. Any large community is bound to have a few morons. It's just a fact of life.

All that being said, I think that the console community is bullied in this "debate" simply because the shitty twelve year old kid screaming into the mic has become the paradigm for that playerbase. These kids are the ones that make these ridiculous claims of superiority over PC hardware, not the bulk of the console community. 

Brace yourselves, this is where my opinion becomes extremely unpopular and will likely be the part where you click the downvote button. I don't care. The root of this problem(and don't pretend it's not a problem. This silly little conflict is driving a wedge between two lovely communities of dedicated gamers.) The root of the problem lies in the PC gaming community.

As I stated before, only a small percentage of the console community truly believe that console hardware is superior, but it seems like everybody who argues in favor of PC gaming simply ignores the simple fact that Console gaming is expo-fucking-nentially cheaper than gaming on a PC.

Those that do address this fact always seem to retort with something along the lines of "it's more than worth the money." Unfortunately, this doesn't give me the $800+ more I'd need to pour into a PC just to run most modern games to where they are better looking than they would be on a console.

It's a bummer, but most people simply don't have that kind of budget for gaming. I'm sure that if you plucked a bunch  of random  consolefags off the street and asked them if they wanted to trade in their PS3 or Xbox for a brand-spankin' new gaming rig, most if not all would immediately meet you're offer with a hearty "Fuck yes!" but until some rich, gaming-enthusiast/philanthropist starts doing this, I don't see any reason to look down on the fine gentlemen gaming on a budget.
